root.name: パワー・インテグレーションズ

relations.text: 1250ボルトと1700ボルトのPowiGaN技術について、800 VDC電力アーキテクチャでNVIDIAと協力していると述べている
relations.text_en: Power Integrations says it is collaborating with NVIDIA on 800 VDC power architecture, citing its 1250- and 1700-volt PowiGaN technologies

source.label: Power Integrations 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: Last month we detailed the capabilities of our 1250- and 1700-volt PowiGaN TM technologies for next-gen AI data centers, including our collaboration with NVIDIA on 800 VDC power architecture.”

relations.text: Wells Fargo Bank, National Associationとのクレジット契約で、7,500万ドルの回転与信枠がある
relations.text_en: Power Integrations has a Credit Agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association providing a $75.0 million revolving line of credit

source.label: Power Integrations 10-K
source.quote: We have a Credit Agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association (the "Credit Agreement") that provides us with a $75.0 million revolving line of credit to use for general corporate purposes with a $20.0 million sub-limit for the issuance of standby and trade letters of credit.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: このクレジット契約は2016年7月27日に締結された
relations.text_en: The credit agreement was entered into on July 27, 2016

source.label: Power Integrations 10-K
source.quote: On July 27, 2016, the Company entered into a credit agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, National Association (the "Credit Agreement") that provides the Company with a $ 75.0 million revolving line of credit to use for general corporate purposes with a $ 20.0 million sub-limit for the issuance of standby and trade letters of credit.

companies.name: モノリシック・パワー・システムズ

relations.text: モノリシック・パワー・システムズの年次報告が、パワー・インテグレーションズを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Power Integrations as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Monolithic Power Systems 10-K
source.quote: We consider our primary competitors to include Analog Devices, Infineon Technologies, NXP Semiconductors, ON Semiconductor, Power Integrations, Renesas Electronics, ROHM Semiconductor, Semtech, STMicroelectronics and Texas Instruments.

companies.name: ナビタス・セミコンダクター

relations.text: ナビタス・セミコンダクターの年次報告が、パワー・インテグレーションズを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Power Integrations as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Navitas Semiconductor 10-K
source.quote: Our primary GaN competitors include Infineon Technologies AG, Power Integrations, Inc., Texas Instruments Incorporated, Innoscience (Suzhou) Semiconductor Co., Ltd., Renesas Electronics Corp., and Efficient Power Conversion Corporation (EPC).

companies.name: STマイクロエレクトロニクス

relations.text: パワー・インテグレーションズの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in Power Integrations’s annual report

source.label: Power Integrations 10-K
source.quote: Competing alternatives to our high-voltage ICs for the power-supply market include monolithic and hybrid ICs from companies such as STMicroelectronics, Infineon Technologies and Sanken Electric Company, as well as PWM-controller chips paired with discrete high-voltage silicon or GaN transistors.

relations.text: モータードライバーICの競合として、パワーモジュールを手がけるSTMicroelectronicsを挙げている
relations.text_en: Names STMicroelectronics among competing power-module suppliers for its motor-driver ICs

source.label: Power Integrations 10-K
source.quote: Our motor-driver ICs compete with power modules from such companies as ON Semiconductor, Infineon, STMicroelectronics, Mitsubishi and Sanken as well as discrete designs from a wide range of other suppliers.

companies.name: テキサス・インスツルメンツ

relations.text: パワー・インテグレーションズの年次報告が、競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Named as a competitor in Power Integrations’s annual report

source.label: Power Integrations 10-K
source.quote: Competing suppliers of high-voltage GaN products include InnoScience, Infineon, Renesas, Texas Instruments, Navitas Semiconductor and others.

relations.text: ゲートドライバー製品の競合として、三菱電機を挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Mitsubishi Electric among competitors to its gate-driver products

source.label: Power Integrations 10-K
source.quote: Our gate-driver products compete with alternatives from such companies as Infineon, Mitsubishi Electric, Fuji Electric, Semikron and Hangzhou Firstack Technology Co., as well as driver circuits made up of discrete devices.
